# dsh-hindsight-local
Run the Hindsight memory server **on your own machine** and load it as a DeepSeek Harness plugin. Me
mory extraction, embedding, retrieval and knowledge pages all stay local; the LLM is the provider yo
u already pay for (DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic / Ollama / …). Nothing is sent to a hosted memory s
dy pay for (DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic / Ollama / …). Nothing is sent to a hosted memory service.
It is the local counterpart of the official `@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` plugin: same men
tal model (one bank per repository, LLM-maintained knowledge pages, per-session injection), but self
-hosted and free apart from your own model calls.
## What it does
- **Runs the server**: finds the `hindsight-api` binary already cached by `uv`, probes `/health`, an

d starts it detached when it is not running (polls until ready, 240 s by default).
- **Injects conte
xt**: once per session it adds the repository's knowledge-page index plus a few recalled facts, capp

ed by `injectMaxChars`.
- **Writes memory back**: when a turn goes idle, the latest user/assistant m

essages are retained into the bank and extracted into structured facts.
- **Gives the model tools**:
ten `hindsight_local_*` tools to search and read pages, recall facts, remember, reflect, inspect st

atus/logs, and start/stop the server.
- **Replaces the export handoff**: at session end it writes a
short **handoff snapshot** (what was asked, the last conclusion, where it stopped) and injects it as
"previous progress" at the start of the next session — no need to paste a whole exported transcript
(see Handoff snapshot).

## Tools
`hindsight_local_status`, `_start`, `_stop`, `_logs`, `_search`, `_read`, `_recall`, `_remember`, `_
atus`, `_start`, `_stop`, `_logs`, `_search`, `_read`, `_recall`, `_remember`, `_reflect`, `_pages`.
## Handoff snapshot
The "handoff document" tab in DSH is a full per-message export of the session (`bili export`, includ
ing chain-of-thought, tool arguments and raw tool output). Pasting it into a new session is long and
expensive: in one measured export, assistant blocks were 63.7% of the file and chain-of-thought alo
ne 47.6%, while what actually matters is where the work stopped and what comes next.
This plugin writes a snapshot instead:
- At session end (`disposed`) it retains a **handoff snapshot** — project path, session id, every us
er request of that session (400 chars each), and the final assistant conclusion (800 chars), capped

by `snapshotMaxChars` (default 1500).
- **Grouping** — every write of one session shares `document_i
d = dsh-session:<session id>`, so the server keeps it as a single document. Snapshot tags are `dsh-s

ession` + `dsh-session-handoff`; per-turn fragments are `dsh-session` + `dsh-session-turn`.
- **Next
session** — the injected block gains a "where it stopped last time" section: at most 3 recalled ite

ms, 220 chars each, never the full text.
- **Inspect** — `hindsight_local_recall("上次会话做到哪一步，下一步要做什么"

)`.
- **Disable** — `handoffSnapshot: false`.
A snapshot is background, not an instruction: the injection says to treat it as context and re-check
before relying on it, so an old conclusion cannot override what the user asks now.
## Keeping data on another drive
By default the server keeps three things under your user profile:
| What | Default | How to move it |
| Embedded PostgreSQL (install + database) | `~/.pg0` | directory junction only (`pg0.exe` hard-code

s its home and the server does not forward `data-dir`) |
| Embedding / reranker model cache | `~/.ca

che/huggingface` | `HF_HOME`, or a junction |
| uv cache (the server executable lives here) | `%LOCA
LAPPDATA%/uv/cache` | `UV_CACHE_DIR`, or a junction |

old paths, starts the server again and checks `/health`):

`dataDir` makes the plugin export `UV_CACHE_DIR`, `HF_HOME` and `SENTENCE_TRANSFORMERS_HOME` before
it spawns the server, so a fresh install can live on another drive without junctions. An existing `~
/.pg0` still has to be moved by `relocate.mjs` (it creates the junction for you).
Each default location can also be overridden with `HINDSIGHT_PG0_DIR`, `HINDSIGHT_HF_DIR`, `HINDSIGH
lt location can also be overridden with `HINDSIGHT_PG0_DIR`, `HINDSIGHT_HF_DIR`, `HINDSIGHT_UV_DIR`.
## Why not `hindsight-embed daemon start`
That wrapper gives up after a fixed 180 s readiness window, while a cold start installs ~450 MB of d
ependencies and downloads the embedding/reranker models (3–5 minutes on a real machine). It reports
`Daemon Failed (Timeout)` while the process keeps initialising. This plugin launches `hindsight-api`
directly and polls `/health` itself.
## Windows notes (handled for you)
- The startup banner contains block characters that crash on a GBK console → `PYTHONUTF8=1` / `PYTHO

NIOENCODING=utf-8` are injected.
- `huggingface_hub` (httpx) does not trust the Windows certificate
store, so the first model download fails with `CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED`. Export your Windows roots
to `~/.hindsight/winroot.pem` and the plugin uses it for `SSL_CERT_FILE` / `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` / `
t/winroot.pem` and the plugin uses it for `SSL_CERT_FILE` / `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` / `CURL_CA_BUNDLE`.
